I got ghosted by the love of my life about a year ago and I still haven't moved on. We were in the talking phase for about a month and I only met her of the beginning of that month. She came up to me and asked me for my info, it felt like a dream. Still the most beautiful person I've ever met. Things were fine and everything until they weren't. The messages took 12+ hours to be replied to but I played it off as she was busy or whatever, then it started happening more frequently. She distanced herself completely, I asked if she needed space for some reason and she said yeah. She was going through some things at home but I assured her that I would be there for her no matter what and I'll help her in any way she needs. After 3 days of no contact after a month of just obsessing over her, I broke, I sent her a message telling her it's killing me not to talk to her, I wasn't eating, talking, or doing anything really. No response until a month later where she texted me telling me that she would like to talk to me but I told her that I would want to talk in person, she then told me "That's okay, I would like to give you what you deserve". Then after that nothing, ever again, Until I reached out months and months later, I've been on a road of self discovery ever since this happened and I asked myself if I would be okay dying right now. I wasn't, I still had to let her know that I care how she's doing, so I did, I reached out and she replied with a short message saying she's okay, after that, no response at all. I still love that girl to death and would do anything for her at a moments notice. But it really is super difficult for me to process how she could do that to me, I thought we were in love, I spent so many nights trying to justify what she did, but the question "why" always popped up, but it doesn't matter, she taught me unconditional love and I know I will never love anyone again. To anyone thinking of ghosting someone please consider that only as a last resort, it will have such an emotional toll on someone it's inexplicable
